name: IAI Astra / Gulfstream G100 / G150
summary: Israel Aircraft Industries' compact 'Westwind successor', sold under Gulfstream marketing as the G100 and the stretched G150.

wings: Low swept wing, slim and highly tapered
Upturned winglets on SPX/G100/G150; plain tips on early Astras
engines: Two Honeywell TFE731 turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Compact, slim fuselage with small oval windows

tellTales: Small T-tail twinjet with a narrow cabin and small oval windows
Slim swept wing, often with small winglets
Compact rear engines on a short body

confusedWith.howToTell: The G200 is a larger, wider-bodied aircraft with a longer fuselage and more windows; the G150/Astra is small and narrow.
Both are small T-tail jets, often with winglets; the Learjet 45 has a more tapered fuselage and sharper nose, while the Astra/G150 has a boxier, wider cabin and a rounder nose.
The Westwind has large wingtip fuel tanks and a low-set tailplane; the Astra has a T-tail and clean wingtips or winglets.
